n_lk4_16.speaker: narrator
n_lk4_16.text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

n_j2_1.speaker: narrator
n_j2_1.text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

n_j2_2.speaker: narrator
n_j2_2.text: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

n_j2_6.speaker: narrator
n_j2_6.text: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

n_j2_9.speaker: narrator
n_j2_9.text: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

n_j2_11.speaker: narrator
n_j2_11.text: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

n_ps119_105.speaker: narrator
n_ps119_105.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

n_prov3_5.speaker: narrator
n_prov3_5.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

n_ps34_8.speaker: narrator
n_ps34_8.text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

j_woman.speaker: jesus
j_woman.text: Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

j_draw.speaker: jesus
j_draw.text: Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast.

m_servants.speaker: mary
m_servants.text: Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

s_taste.speaker: steward
s_taste.text: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

j_invite.speaker: jesus
j_invite.text: Come with me to Cana. There is a wedding, and we are invited.

naomi_ask.speaker: naomi
naomi_ask.text: Friend, I dropped my father's scroll near the olive tree. Could you find it for me?

naomi_thanks.speaker: naomi
naomi_thanks.text: Bless you! Keep its words close, friend. They will light your road.

sv_brim.speaker: servant
sv_brim.text: They are full, right up to the brim.

g1.speaker: guest
g1.text: Wine? But those jars held only water!

g2.speaker: guestf
g2.text: Taste it! I have never tasted wine so good.

n_lk2_8.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_8.text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

n_lk2_9.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_9.text: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

n_lk2_13_14.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_13_14.text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying, Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

n_lk2_16.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_16.text: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

n_lk2_24.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_24.text: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

n_lk2_38.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_38.text: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

n_lk2_40.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_40.text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

n_lk2_52.speaker: narrator
n_lk2_52.text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

n_lk3_23.speaker: narrator
n_lk3_23.text: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

n_mt2_1.speaker: narrator
n_mt2_1.text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

n_mt2_9.speaker: narrator
n_mt2_9.text: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

n_mt2_10_11.speaker: narrator
n_mt2_10_11.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy. And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

n_mt2_12.speaker: narrator
n_mt2_12.text: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

a_tidings.speaker: angel
a_tidings.text: Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

a_sign.speaker: angel
a_sign.text: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

sh_go.speaker: shepherd
sh_go.text: Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

s_depart.speaker: simeon
s_depart.text: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation, Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people; A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

w_ask.speaker: wise
w_ask.text: Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

sh_send.speaker: shepherd
sh_send.text: Keep the lambs close to the fire, little one. The night is long, and we must watch.

sh_done.speaker: shepherd
sh_done.text: Well done. They are all in the fold.

sh_town.speaker: shepherd
sh_town.text: Stay close to us, little one. Look into each stable and tell us where you see it.

dove_seller.speaker: seller
dove_seller.text: Quick, little one! Two of my doves have flown loose. Bring them back to the cage!

wise_thank.speaker: wise
wise_thank.text: Thank you, little one. We will follow the road you have drawn.

n_ps23_1.speaker: narrator
n_ps23_1.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

n_stone_lk2_11.speaker: narrator
n_stone_lk2_11.text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

sh_road.speaker: shepherd
sh_road.text: The lambs have scattered along the road. Gather them, little one, and bring them home to the fire.

sh_camp_all.speaker: shepherd
sh_camp_all.text: Every one of them is here. You led them well.

sh_camp_lost.speaker: shepherd
sh_camp_lost.text: Some wandered in the dark. Listen. They are finding the fire.
